format: In-person clinic, 2 days (athlete + coach tracks)
name: Ascent Track Clinics — Summer Track & Field Clinic at George Mason
notes: Closest elite clinic to DC: training in every event group plus coaches-only classroom sessions with Boo Schexnayder, Kebba Tolbert and Andrew Gerard; 2027 dates listed as TBD on the site.

format: In-person clinic/convention, 2 days (annual, summer)
location: Virginia (host site rotates; past editions in Harrisonburg, VA)
name: Virginia Track Coaches Association (VTCA) Summer Coaches Clinic
notes: Virginia's HS coaches association clinic — annual membership ($35/yr per the registration page) includes the summer clinic, with speakers across all event groups; dates/pricing on the site.

format: In-person state clinic, 1 day
location: Maryland (past hosts include University of Maryland, College Park)
name: NSCA Maryland State Clinic
notes: NSCA's Maryland state event — the posted itinerary includes a session on autoregulation/long-term athletic development programming for high school athletes; check the page for the current date and pricing.

format: Blended certification course, 22 hours (online modules + in-person school)
location: Regional host sites nationwide — past schools at Johns Hopkins (Baltimore, MD) and Richmond, VA
name: USATF Level 1 Program (Blended)
notes: The cornerstone USATF coach certification covering sport science plus all event groups; Level 1 schools run regularly in the mid-Atlantic, so a DC coach can usually drive to one — check the USATF calendar on the site for current dates/pricing.

format: In-person convention, 4 days (Dec 14-17, 2026)
name: USTFCCCA Convention 2026 (#USTFCCCA26)
notes: The sport's premier coaching convention (1,500+ coaches): technical sessions, Spy Coaching (incl. Dan Pfaff in 2026) and 14 pro-development seminars; $450 if registered before Dec 1, $575 after, per USTFCCCA.

format: In-person certification course, ~21 hours (offered around Convention and in summer)
location: Grapevine, TX (with Convention) and rotating host sites
name: Track & Field Academy Strength & Conditioning Coach Certification (Course 310)
notes: Boo Schexnayder-led, NCACE-accredited S&C certification built specifically for track coaches — speed/power training, weight-room program design and testing; a natural complement to the CSCS. Dates/pricing on the site.

format: Blended advanced certification (Level 2: 32 hours; Level 3: year-long seminar + capstone)
location: National host sites (past schools at IMG Academy, Bradenton, FL and Chula Vista, CA)
name: USATF Level 2 & Level 3 Programs — Sprints/Hurdles/Relays
notes: The event-specific rungs of the USATF pathway: Level 2 goes deep on sprints/hurdles/relays and writing a full training plan (needs Level 1 + 2 yrs coaching); Level 3 is the high-performance seminar tier.

format: In-person immersion, 4 days
name: ALTIS Apprentice Coach Program (ACP)
notes: Live inside an elite sprint training center: observe track and weight-room sessions and daily roundtables with Dan Pfaff, Stuart McMillan, Andreas Behm and Kevin Tyler; new session dates are posted on the ALTIS site (most recent listed: May 7-10, 2025).

format: In-person clinic, 2 days (flagship + regional stops)
location: Chicago, IL flagship; regional editions (past: Dallas, St. Louis, Tampa, Wichita)
name: Track Football Consortium (TFC) Clinics
notes: The Feed the Cats speed-first clinic circuit for HS track and football coaches — Holler, Korfist and guest sprint speakers; built around timed, recorded, ranked sprinting. Current dates/pricing on the site.
provider: Track Football Consortium (Tony Holler & Chris Korfist)

format: In-person + online hybrid conference, 4 days (July)
location: Rotating — 2026: New Orleans, LA; 2027: Las Vegas, NV (Jul 7-10)
name: NSCA National Conference (NSCACon)
notes: NSCA's flagship event; since 2025 it absorbs the former Coaches Conference, so it carries the coach-focused practical content plus up to 3.0 CEUs — directly useful for keeping a CSCS current after the exam.

format: In-person annual conference (application-based) + online master class series
name: GAIN Network Annual Conference & Master Classes
notes: Vern Gambetta's small, application-only professional network for S&C coaches, sport coaches and therapists — heavy on athletic development and training design discussion rather than lectures. Dates/pricing on the site.

format: In-person mentorship courses (multi-day, phased 1-3)
location: Exos HQ, Phoenix, AZ + international host sites
name: Exos Performance Mentorships (Phase 1-3)
notes: Hands-on immersion in the Exos training system (mindset, nutrition, movement, recovery); Phase 1 at Exos HQ Phoenix is listed for Mar 8, 2027 on the events page, with Phase 2/3 following — no prerequisites for Phase 1.

format: In-person state clinics (1 day) + annual national convention
location: State host sites nationwide + rotating national site
name: NHSSCA State Clinics & National Convention
notes: The only S&C association built specifically for high school coaches — the 2026 Illinois clinic agenda pairs Tony Holler on getting fast in limited indoor space with weight-room speed sessions; check the site for the current state clinic list and convention dates.
provider: National High School Strength Coaches Association (NHSSCA)

format: Online, self-paced (12 modules, ~24 hours of content, lifetime access)
name: ALTIS Coaching the Short Sprints
notes: Dan Pfaff and the ALTIS staff's flagship sprint course: technical models for the 60/100/200m, block-start progressions, programming and error correction — arguably the single most on-target course for a HS sprint coach. Price on the site.

format: Online courses + membership video library (new videos monthly)
name: ALTIS Digital Education & ALTIS Connect
notes: The wider ALTIS catalog beyond the sprints course — digital courses from Pfaff, McMillan and guests, plus the Connect library of behind-the-scenes training footage and 'Poolside Chats' (14-day free trial noted on the page).

format: Online, self-paced certification course (15 hours)
name: Track & Field Academy Online Courses — TFTC Online
notes: The Track & Field Technical Certification taught fully online: training design plus technical instruction for every event group, sprints/hurdles/relays included; stacks toward the Academy's Master's Endorsement. Price on the site.

format: Online, self-paced study course with 160+ activities and end-of-course exam
name: CSCS Online Study/CE Course (5th Edition)
notes: The official NSCA/Human Kinetics companion to Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning built to mirror the CSCS exam blueprint — direct prep support for the Oct 30 exam, and it doubles as CEUs once certified.

format: Online, self-paced courses and certification
name: Exos Online Courses & Performance Specialist (XPS) Certification
notes: Exos's online catalog: the full XPS certification (listed at $1,130 on the Exos course store) plus targeted courses sprint coaches will use, including 'The 0.10 Second Difference' on speed development and Advanced Strength and Power with Dan Baker.

format: Blended: 2-day in-person course or online format + USAW Learning Academy modules
name: USA Weightlifting Level 1 Coach Course
notes: Teaches USAW's five-stage progressions for the snatch, clean and jerk plus squats/presses and error correction — sharpens coaching of the power lifts HS sprinters actually use in the weight room; course listings run ~$549, with current schedule on the USAW site.

format: Online certification courses (L1 ~5 hrs, L2 ~7 hrs) via FMS Academy
name: FMS Level 1 & Level 2 (Functional Movement Screen)
notes: Movement screening and corrective-exercise system (Gray Cook's FMS): L1 teaches the screen, L2 the corrective progressions — useful for spotting the mobility/stability issues behind the aches-and-pains log. Pricing on the site.

format: Online, self-paced course (~5 clock hours) with certificate
name: Coaching Track and Field (NFHS Learning Center)
notes: Developed by USATF with the NFHS and hosted by Olympians Dan O'Brien and Hyleas Fountain — fundamentals of running, jumping and throwing mechanics; counts toward the USATF Coaches Registry education standard and NFHS coaching credentials.

format: Online video courses, self-paced (multi-course certification series)
name: Feed the Cats Certification Courses (Holler Shop)
notes: Tony Holler's full Feed the Cats course library (sprint-based training, plus guest courses like Chris Korfist's 'Stiffness' and Alec Holler's hurdling) — the online companion to the TFC clinics, aimed squarely at HS coaches. Prices on the site.

format: Online articles/Q&As, free, self-paced
name: SimpliFaster Coach Education Articles & Freelap Friday Five
notes: Free, deep archive of practitioner-written speed and S&C content (timing with Freelap, sprint programming, HS program case studies) — the best no-cost continuing education in the sprint space; new material posts weekly.
